eurosys26.alt: Thor overall workflow, Figure 2 from the original paper.
eurosys26.summary_en: Combines hybrid message generation, two-tier parallel fuzzing and log-based oracles to test enterprise blockchain systems.
eurosys26.summary_zh: 结合主动与被动消息生成、两级并行测试和日志断言，对企业级区块链系统进行测试。

sp26.alt: Camveil overall workflow, Figure 3 from the original paper.
sp26.summary_en: Coordinates HTTP, RTSP and ONVIF through a camera status model to find vulnerabilities caused by interactions between protocols.
sp26.summary_zh: 通过摄像头状态模型协调 HTTP、RTSP 和 ONVIF，发现协议交互引起的安全问题。

ase2501.alt: Dualfuzz overall workflow, Figure 5 from the original paper.
ase2501.summary_en: Models interactions between Wi-Fi transmission and reception, then uses latency feedback to guide coordinated fuzzing.
ase2501.summary_zh: 建模 Wi-Fi 网卡发送与接收过程的相互影响，利用时延反馈指导双向协同测试。

security25.alt: Horcrux overall workflow, Figure 3 from the original paper.
security25.summary_en: Models relationships between cross-node file operations and uses temporary inconsistency duration to guide testing.
security25.summary_zh: 建模跨节点文件操作之间的关系，以临时不一致的持续时间指导测试，发现元数据一致性问题。

chen2024chronos.alt: Chronos overall workflow, Figure 4 from the original paper.
chen2024chronos.summary_en: Combines runtime delay injection, deep-priority search and transient delays to find timeout bugs in distributed systems.
chen2024chronos.summary_zh: 结合运行时延迟注入、深度优先级搜索与瞬态延迟，发现分布式系统的超时处理缺陷。

ma2023loki.alt: Loki overall workflow, Figure 4 from the original paper.
ma2023loki.summary_en: Joins the system as a node, tracks consensus states and generates messages to test consensus protocol implementations.
ma2023loki.summary_zh: 作为节点加入系统，跟踪共识状态并生成测试消息，发现共识协议实现中的内存与逻辑缺陷。

jiang2026usec.alt: USEC security interface workflow, Figure 6 from the original paper.
jiang2026usec.summary_en: Uses resource-centric policy templates, demand-driven permission checks and LSM-compatible interfaces to simplify Linux mandatory access control.
jiang2026usec.summary_zh: 通过面向资源的策略模板、按需权限检查与兼容 LSM 的接口，简化 Linux 内核的强制访问控制。
